settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.language.cardHelper: Pick a language for the interface. Translations are community-driven - missing strings fall back to English.
settings.fontScale.helper: Bumps the base font size. Use Large or X-Large when viewing on a TV from across the room.
settings.fontScale.label: Font scale
settings.density.label: Density
settings.density.helper: Tightens or loosens spacing in lists and menus. Independent of font scale.
settings.perfMode.title: Performance mode
settings.perfMode.label: Performance mode
settings.perfMode.helperLong: Disables decorative animations (the comet in the sidebar, hub entry stagger, sliding focus ring) for smoother scrolling and D-pad navigation on TV boxes and low-end devices.
settings.rendering.title: Rendering
settings.rendering.helperLong: Some Linux graphics drivers (Raspberry Pi, Nvidia proprietary, virtual machines) show a garbled screen or crash on launch with the default renderer. Safe mode works around this at a small performance cost.
settings.rendering.label: Rendering mode
settings.rendering.hint: Auto turns on safe mode only on hardware known to have problems. Faster is applied as a trial after a restart: if you do not confirm keeping it, the app switches back on the next launch.
settings.rendering.envOverrideNote: A WebKit rendering variable is set outside the app, so this control is disabled.
settings.rendering.escapeHatches: If the app becomes unusable, run it once with --safe-rendering from a terminal to switch back to safe rendering permanently.
settings.rendering.trialRestartNote: Restart to try faster rendering. If the screen looks broken afterwards, close and reopen the app - it switches back automatically.
settings.rendering.restartNote: Restart the app to apply this change.
settings.uiSounds.title: Interface sounds
settings.uiSounds.label: Interface sounds
settings.uiSounds.helperLong: A soft chime when the app starts and gentle ticks when moving around with a remote or keyboard. Mouse and touch stay silent.
settings.haptics.title: Touch feedback
settings.haptics.label: Touch feedback
settings.haptics.helperLong: A tiny vibration when you star a favorite or add to your watchlist by touch. Follows the system touch-feedback setting.
settings.tvOverscan.title: TV safe area
settings.tvOverscan.label: Edge inset
settings.tvOverscan.helperLong: Most TVs hide a small band at each edge of the picture (overscan). If sidebar icons or version text look cut off, increase this to inset the whole UI by a few percent.
settings.closeBehavior.title: Close button behavior
settings.closeBehavior.label: Close button
settings.closeBehavior.helper: What happens when you click the window's X. "Minimize to tray" keeps the app running in the system tray so background features (programme reminders, downloads) keep working. "Quit" exits the app like other windows.
settings.androidNativePlayer.title: Native Android video player
settings.androidNativePlayer.helper: Plays movies, series, and live channels through Android's built-in ExoPlayer instead of the in-app player, with proper Picture-in-Picture, lock-screen and Bluetooth controls. Off by default; the app may still switch to it automatically if a channel can't be decoded in-app.
settings.androidNativePlayer.label: Native ExoPlayer
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.accent.label: Accent color
settings.accent.overrideHint: The active playlist overrides this color.
settings.danger.resetConfirm: Reset everything? This wipes playlists, favorites, recents, downloads metadata, and cached catalogs. The action cannot be undone.
tray.notice.title: Still running in the tray
tray.notice.body: Extreme InfiniTV keeps running in the system tray. Click the tray icon to open it again, or right-click for Quit.

login.field.title: Title
login.field.emoji.helper: Shown instead of the type badge.
login.field.accent.helper: Overrides the app's accent color while this playlist is active.
login.field.serverUrl.helper: Paste a full player_api.php URL to auto-fill the fields below, or enter just the hostname.
login.field.playlistUrl.helper: Any URL that serves an M3U playlist. Extension and scheme optional.
login.field.localFile.helper: Pick a .m3u or .m3u8 file from your device. The contents are stored with this playlist so you can keep watching without re-picking the file.
login.epg.advancedHelper: Override the provider's XMLTV guide, or stack extra sources to fill missing channels.
login.epg.primaryHelper: XMLTV URL. Plain XML or gzipped (.xml.gz). Overrides the auto-detected source.
login.epg.primaryPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the provider's default
login.epg.additionalHelper: Stacked in order. Each one fills channels the previous sources didn't supply - they never override the primary.
login.epg.invalidUrl: Must start with http:// or https:// and contain no spaces.
login.epg.duplicateUrl: Duplicate URL - same as another source.
login.epg.testNoSources: Nothing to test - add at least one URL first.
login.epg.disableProviderLabel: Don't use the provider's default EPG
login.epg.disableProviderHelper: Skip the auto-detected source. Only the URLs above will be used - lets you verify a custom EPG works on its own.
login.mirrors.helper: Providers often hand out a couple of domains. We'll fall back automatically when the primary stops responding.
login.advanced.helper: Tweak how stream URLs are built. Only change if your provider needs it.
login.field.liveContainer.helper: Most providers use HLS. Switch to MPEG-TS only if your provider can't serve .m3u8.
backup.failoverNoticeBody: Your primary domain stopped responding. We switched to a backup so you can keep watching.
epg.map.title: Map channels to EPG
epg.map.help: Each channel below is matched to an EPG entry by tvg-id. Use override to point a channel at a different EPG channel manually.

settings.playback.backend.artplayerAndro: Not supported on Android - Video.js is used instead.

settings.langGrouping.title: Group language variants
settings.langGrouping.hint: Combine copies of the same title in different languages into one entry. Turn off if titles are grouped incorrectly for your provider.
settings.contentLang.title: Preferred audio language
settings.contentLang.hint: When a title exists in several languages, open and recommend this one first. Auto follows the interface language.
settings.playback.audioTranscodeAutoHelp: When a live channel plays video with no sound (AC-3, E-AC-3, MP2, or DTS audio), fix it automatically instead of asking each time.
settings.playback.ffmpegPathHelper: Point to your own FFmpeg if the bundled one is missing or you prefer a specific build.

settings.monoAudio.title: Mono audio
settings.monoAudio.label: Mono audio
settings.monoAudio.helperLong: Play all audio in both ears as a single channel - useful with one earbud. Applies to streams played by the built-in engines; some directly played files keep their original stereo.
settings.captionsAuto.title: Captions on by default
settings.captionsAuto.helperLong: Automatically turns on subtitles when a movie or episode has them, preferring your app language. You can still turn them off in the player. Applies to this device.
settings.captionsAuto.label: Captions on by default

settings.network.helperLong: Some IPTV providers reject the default browser User-Agent. Pick a preset or enter a custom string. Applies to provider API, M3U, and EPG fetches. Effective in the desktop build.
settings.network.timeoutHelper: How long to wait for a provider response before giving up. Bump this when a large catalog times out before it finishes loading.
settings.devMode.title: Developer mode
settings.devMode.helperLong: Unlocks a network log of recent provider requests, useful when troubleshooting a connection issue. Off by default.
settings.devMode.label: Developer mode
settings.netLog.title: Network log
settings.netLog.helper: Recent provider requests, with credentials stripped. Kept for this app session only and cleared when you close the app.
settings.discord.helperLong: Show "Watching X on Extreme InfiniTV" on your Discord profile while you use the app. On by default; uncheck a playlist below to mute presence for that account. Desktop only - requires Discord running on the same machine.
settings.tmdb.title: TMDb metadata
settings.tmdb.helper: Enrich movies and series with better posters, cast, trailers, and similar titles from The Movie Database.
settings.tmdb.privacy: When enabled, the titles you open are sent to TMDB for matching.
settings.tmdb.apiKeyHelper: Paste a free TMDB API key or v4 access token.
settings.downloadsFolder.intro: Folder where new downloads land. Manage the queue itself on the Downloads page.
settings.downloadsFolder.notSetPlacehold: Not set - picked on first download
settings.downloadsFolder.restoreHelper: After a reinstall, scan the folder above for `.xtmeta.json` sidecars and re-add the matching files to your downloads list.
settings.downloadsFolder.concurrencyHelp: Most Xtream providers cap connections per account, so a second parallel download fails mid-stream. Keep this at 1 unless your provider explicitly allows multiple slots.
settings.downloadsFolder.nfoHelper: Save a .nfo file with title, year, plot and poster next to each finished download so Kodi, Jellyfin or Emby can index it.
diagnostic.verdict.partial: Connection works, but some endpoints had issues.

settings.favoritesSection.helperLong: Reorder your favorites per kind. The hub Favorites strip and the per-page favorites filter follow this order.
settings.backup.helperLong: Save all playlists, favorites, recents, watched progress, hidden categories, and app settings to a file. Cache and the downloads queue are not exported.
settings.storage.helperLong: Clears channel, movie, and series lists. Playlists, favorites, and recents are kept.

update.openAboutHint: Open Settings > About to get it.
settings.about.linuxAppImageNotice: Auto-updates on Linux are only delivered to the AppImage build. For deb / rpm installs, grab new versions from the GitHub releases page above.
settings.licenses.title: Licenses and attribution
settings.licenses.ffmpegNotice: The Windows and Linux desktop builds bundle a trimmed FFmpeg build (LGPL v2.1 or later), used only to convert live TV audio the app can't otherwise play.
settings.licenses.mpegtsPatch: mpegts.js ships with a small audio-track fallback patch.

settings.help.intro: Bug reports, feature requests, questions, and general feedback all go to GitHub - search existing issues first, or pick a template and open a new one.
settings.help.exportDiagnosticsHelper: Save a single file with app and device details, recent network activity, playlist types and the newest log files. Attach it to a bug report so the problem can be traced.
settings.help.diagnosticsPrivacy: Usernames, passwords and tokens are stripped out. Server names can still appear, so review the file before posting it publicly.
settings.support.intro: Extreme InfiniTV is free and open source. If it saves you time or sweetens your living-room setup, a small tip helps cover hosting, signing certs, and the next round of features.
settings.support.fineprint: No tracking, no ads, no telemetry - just a thank-you button.
settings.danger.helperLong: Wipes all app data: playlists, cached lists, favorites, recents, and locally stored EPG references. Next launch starts from a clean slate.
settings.danger.dialogBody: This wipes all playlists, favorites, recents, and cached lists. This can't be undone.
settings.danger.restoreLastHelper: Restores the snapshot saved automatically at your last export or right before your last reset.
settings.hiddenCategories.helperLong: Hidden categories don't appear in the picker or main grid. Use the eye icon on a category row to hide it; unhide here.
settings.hiddenCategories.emptyState: No hidden categories for this playlist.
settings.favoritesReorder.helperLong: Drag a row, or use the up/down buttons. The hub Favorites strip and per-page lists follow this order.
settings.favoritesReorder.emptyState: Star a channel, movie, or series to add it here.
